ideas.title: Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the scope of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and the efforts of law enforcement to combat it
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are law enforcement agencies addressing the issue?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose widespread fraud and corruption in Minnesota's Medicaid program. By following the money and analyzing public records, we can uncover the truth and hold those responsible accountable.
